Definition: Does the government maintain a digital business register?
Comments: Business registration in Benin is handled through the Guichet Unique de Formalisation des Entreprises (GUFE) described as an online one-stop platform, implying a partially deployed digital business register process (RCCM issuance).
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: ILO documentation confirms Benin's monentreprise.bj platform (launched by APIEX on 17 Feb 2020) enables fully online, nationwide business creation (RCCM, IFU, legal notice, labour declaration issued digitally, typically under 3 hours); current APIEX/CCIB guidance (2025-26) corroborates this is the standing national process. The cited blog was a low-quality marketing source; on stronger evidence the register is fully, not partially, deployed nationwide, so the code is raised to 5.
